citation.authors: Gaston SA, Feinstein L, Slopen N et al

cited_by.title: Sleep, short sleep and sleep apnoea

record.population: 40,038 US women in the Sister Study (8% non-Hispanic Black)
record.design: Cross-sectional survey of reported discrimination and sleep
record.finding: Non-Hispanic Black participants most often reported everyday (76%) and major (52%) racial discrimination. Reporting both types was linked to short sleep (prevalence ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.09 to 1.25) and insomnia symptoms (1.10, 1.01 to 1.20).
record.note: Women only, cross-sectional, self-report; the excerpt I read cut off before the Black-only subgroup results.
